recreation_entertainment_activity.label: Recreation / entertainment activity
recreation_entertainment_activity.value: Location-based entertainment: bowling centers with dining, bars and arcades; family entertainment centers; waterparks; Professional Bowlers Association (PBA) pro bowling media and events.

venue_service_capacity.label: Venue / service capacity
venue_service_capacity.value: Large North American network of bowling centers across many states, plus family entertainment centers and several waterparks; lanes, arcades, bars and party/event space per venue.

pass_membership_mix.label: Pass / membership mix
pass_membership_mix.value: Revenue from league play, birthday and corporate party bookings, and walk-in lane, food and beverage spend; not membership-driven.

seasonality_utilization.label: Seasonality / utilization
seasonality_utilization.value: Waterparks draw guests in the warm season and are summer-led; bowling centers are used year-round for leagues, evenings and holiday parties.

notes: Evidence gives no figures on capacity, attendance, yield or pass mix; those are unknown. Seasonality is only evidenced for waterparks.
